legacy_articles.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rows, md5(string_agg(md5(row_to_json(a)::text), '' ORDER BY id)) AS row_hash FROM articles a WHERE processing_track='legacy'

legacy_summary_pending.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS rows FROM articles WHERE processing_track='legacy' AND summary_failures < 3 AND (summary_zh IS NULL OR coalesce(((summary_grounding['reading'])->>'input_hash'), '') != md5(title || '
' || coalesce(content, '')) OR summary_grounding->>'status'='review_limited' OR ((summary_grounding['reading'])->>'reason') IN ('language_invalid','title_unverified') OR coalesce(((summary_grounding['reading'])->>'version'), '') != 'reading-v1')

legacy_summary_abandoned.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rows FROM articles WHERE processing_track='legacy' AND summary_failures >= 3

legacy_runs.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rows, md5(string_agg(md5(row_to_json(t)::text), '' ORDER BY id)) AS row_hash FROM pipeline_runs t

digests.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rows, md5(string_agg(md5(row_to_json(t)::text), '' ORDER BY id)) AS row_hash FROM digests t

source_ownership.sql: SELECT owner,enabled,count(*) AS rows FROM source_states GROUP BY owner,enabled ORDER BY owner,enabled

usage.sql: SELECT count(*) AS rows,sum(cost_usd::numeric) AS known_usd FROM llm_usage

unknown.sql: SELECT id,status,stage,reserved_usd,provider_generation_id FROM billed_requests WHERE status IN ('reserved','usage_unknown') ORDER BY id
